# Risk Register

| ID    | Risk                                                               | Impact | Planned control                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -----: | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| R-001 | False positives caused by dynamic JSX values                       |   High | Narrow rule conditions, explicit confidence, negative fixtures, document limits                                                                                    |
| R-002 | False negatives from component abstractions                        |   High | Preserve source locations and component relationships; record unsupported cases                                                                                    |
| R-003 | Parser incompatibility with valid syntax                           |   High | Exact Babel 8 adapter, source-kind-specific plugins, four-language fixture matrix, typed per-file isolation, and documented optional-syntax limits                 |
| R-004 | Symlink loops or traversal outside project                         |   High | Fail-closed default/invalid-policy link skipping; opt-in canonical containment, target exclusions, visited realpaths, and cycle/external-link tests                |
| R-005 | Malicious source text injected into HTML report                    |   High | Escape all project-controlled values and test XSS payloads                                                                                                         |
| R-006 | Large projects consume excessive memory/time                       | Medium | Exclusions, bounded source bytes and AST visits, one sequential parse per candidate, deterministic inventory, and reproducible benchmark fixtures                  |
| R-007 | Rule errors terminate the entire audit                             | Medium | Isolated evaluation and normalized execution errors                                                                                                                |
| R-008 | Agent changes architecture while solving a local task              |   High | Active ExecPlan, contracts, traceability, architecture gate                                                                                                        |
| R-009 | Documentation and state drift                                      | Medium | Machine state, integrity script, required closure updates                                                                                                          |
| R-010 | Dependency or supply-chain vulnerability                           |   High | Exact lockfile, strict peers/scripts, immutable action SHAs, Dependabot, CodeQL, Dependency Review, and audit evidence                                             |
| R-011 | UX rule claims exceed static-analysis capability                   |   High | Stable/experimental/deferred status and evidence-based promotion                                                                                                   |
| R-012 | GitHub push or PR automation unavailable                           |    Low | Local commits, explicit blocker record, no false success claims                                                                                                    |
| R-013 | Current toolchain packages have incompatible engine or peer ranges | Medium | Pin exact reviewed versions, enforce Node.js 24/npm engines and strict peers, preserve the lockfile, and verify the resolved tree                                  |
| R-014 | CLI output exposes native details or injects terminal controls     | Medium | Typed errors, injected streams, no stack output, visible control/bidirectional escapes, hostile-output tests, and stable exits                                     |
| R-015 | Root permissions or canonical target change after preflight        | Medium | Preserve the validated root; revalidate root/file identity and containment around a no-follow file-handle open; read the verified handle; isolate per-file changes |
| R-016 | Hosted CI behavior differs from local verification                 | Medium | Three stable runner images, exact Node/action versions, portable smokes, workflow dispatch, and post-push status review                                            |
